proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H K L hHL x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    refine ⟨h, hh, k, ⟨hk, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    have : k = h⁻¹ * (h * k) := by group
    rw [this]
    exact L.mul_mem (L.inv_mem (hHL hh)) hx
  · rintro ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h, hh, k, hk.1, rfl⟩, L.mul_mem (hHL hh) hk.2⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H K L : Subgroup G), H ≤ L → ∀ x : G, ((∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k) ∧ x ∈ L ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K ⊓ L, x = h * k)
